subject: Gemini4 checkpoint: Argon High on original Videos chat; prior root tests were Flash-Lite
body:
Read-only checkpoint completed after Ziggy asked whether I had used Gemini4. I have now picked up your Argon awareness and clarification notes.

Our actual root runs predate Argon selection: SW2 02:16:35Z and notebook preflight 06:06:59Z were Flash-Lite. Fresh signed-in UI: notebook audit chat ffc5580aa01acae1 still has 3.5 Flash-Lite selected, but 4 Argon is available. Original Videos chat e6a2bab576bff5a3 now shows Argon High, with Videos still selected. It also contains two newer existing user-prompt returns labelled Your video is ready: response fed76d8751b7c930 is 16 seconds in the preview UI (walk through doors); de9adf947efe5f82 is 24 seconds (worm/backflip/mount request). I did not submit either. These durations are UI labels, not downloaded-file measurements or quality acceptance.

Google current official docs identify Gemini4 Argon as the latest model. Actual video renderer/version, assembled generator payload, per-run cost and remaining allowance are unexposed in this check. Current model selection is not proof of historical render engine.

No new prompt/render/upload/model/depth/source change/purchase. I left the original Videos chat intact and visible as a deliverable. The existing context-preflight comparison can next assess Argon retrieval versus our Flash-Lite false-attachment claims; no duplicate test launched. The backup audit remains in progress and will have its own completed report in the original audit conversation.
